aeroscapes_reimagine.race.title: Character sheet
aeroscapes_reimagine.race.sheet_hint: View your appearance, starting abilities, profession kit and combined traits.
aeroscapes_reimagine.race.next_style: Show the next style on your skin. All styles have the same traits.
aeroscapes_reimagine.race.ear_tint_hint: Follow the color of your skin.
aeroscapes_reimagine.race.permanent: Confirm to enter the world with these choices. They persist after death and when you rejoin.
aeroscapes_reimagine.race.human.name: Human
aeroscapes_reimagine.race.human.descript: 10 hearts and 1,000 stamina. Humans have the usual height, movement speed, reach and practice gains.
aeroscapes_reimagine.race.dwarf.name: Dwarf
aeroscapes_reimagine.race.dwarf.descript: 12 hearts and 1,100 stamina. Short and sturdy, dwarves move 5%% slower, resist knockback and tolerate a little more cold. Prepare Dwarven night vision to switch it on or off.
aeroscapes_reimagine.race.goblin.name: Goblin
aeroscapes_reimagine.race.goblin.descrip: 8 hearts and 850 stamina. Goblins fit through a one-block opening when crouched and sneak faster than humans. They can jump up a block and reach just as far as a human.
aeroscapes_reimagine.race.elf.name: Elf
aeroscapes_reimagine.race.elf.descriptio: 9 hearts and 900 stamina. Tall and lean, elves move 6%% faster and gain 20%% more archery and magic practice. Prepare Elven light to illuminate your path for one minute.
aeroscapes_reimagine.race.grant_pending: Your choices are saved. Retry to receive your starting abilities, or leave and return later.
aeroscapes_reimagine.race.retry: Your choices are still on this screen. The server has not confirmed them. Try again or go back to edit.
aeroscapes_reimagine.race.vessels: All races can gain up to 20 extra hearts and 2,000 stamina from vessels. The starting differences still apply at that limit. Equipment adds its own bonuses.
aeroscapes_reimagine.race.no_class_penal: None. Choosing this class preserves your race's learning bonuses and every skill's ceiling.
aeroscapes_reimagine.race.practice_help: 100%% is the ordinary gain. Bonuses from race, class and profession add together. At 140%%, an action worth 10 practice XP earns 14.
aeroscapes_reimagine.race.talent_access: Your class pays for the starting talent. You can spend the usual starting combat point on another talent. All classes can learn these abilities through the same tree.
aeroscapes_reimagine.race.mage_start: Know the eight rank-1 spells of First Magic Mastery. You receive a Flimsy Journal as a focus. Equip a spellbook in the book slot, then assign spells to your eight preparation slots. Casts use their usual mana and cooldowns.
aeroscapes_reimagine.race.light_weapons: Light weapons include the five Farmer’s Delight knives, the Wetland Whimsy dagger and the amethyst rapier from Iron’s Spells ’n Spellbooks.
aeroscapes_reimagine.race.human.benefits: Ordinary starting attributes: 10 hearts and 1,000 stamina. Humans have no innate ability or learning bonus.
aeroscapes_reimagine.race.human.drawback: None. Health, stamina and movement use the standard values.
aeroscapes_reimagine.race.human.body: Human height, reach and movement set the baseline. All three appearances use the same body.
aeroscapes_reimagine.race.dwarf.benefits: 12 hearts (+2), 1,100 stamina (+100), +0.15 knockback resistance and +1 cold resistance. Prepare Dwarven Night Vision to toggle it at will.
aeroscapes_reimagine.race.dwarf.drawback: Ground movement is 5%% slower than a human's.
aeroscapes_reimagine.race.dwarf.body: Shorter and broader than a human. The racial body preserves normal block reach and one-block jumps. Night vision works without a spellbook.
aeroscapes_reimagine.race.goblin.benefit: Crouch through openings one block high. Sneak at 42%% of walking speed, compared with 30%% for a human.
aeroscapes_reimagine.race.goblin.drawbac: 8 hearts (2 fewer than a human) and 850 stamina (150 less).
aeroscapes_reimagine.race.goblin.body: Small and compact. Your body keeps the usual base block reach and one-block jump.
aeroscapes_reimagine.race.elf.benefits: +6%% ground speed and +20%% practice from archery and magic. Prepare Elven Light for a minute of illumination that follows you.
aeroscapes_reimagine.race.elf.drawbacks: 9 hearts (1 fewer than a human) and 900 stamina (100 less).
aeroscapes_reimagine.race.elf.body: Tall and lean. Fits through a two-block doorway and keeps the usual base reach. Elven Light works without a spellbook. Use torches to prevent mobs from spawning.
A close-range fighter who can hold a passage with a shield.
+2 armor, including with an empty armor slot. +20%% melee practice.
aeroscapes_reimagine.race.class.ranger.d: An archer who can fight on the move or take careful shots from cover.
aeroscapes_reimagine.race.class.ranger.b: A fully drawn bow launches arrows 10%% faster. +20%% archery practice.
aeroscapes_reimagine.race.class.mage.des: A spellcaster with attacks, healing and protection available from the start.
aeroscapes_reimagine.race.class.rogue.de: A mobile melee fighter who exploits openings with a light weapon.
aeroscapes_reimagine.race.class.rogue.be: +5%% ground speed while holding a light weapon in your main hand, such as a knife, dagger or amethyst rapier. +20%% melee practice.
aeroscapes_reimagine.race.rogue_speed: On the ground with a light weapon in the main hand: %s%% speed.
aeroscapes_reimagine.race.stat_sources: Race sets your hearts, stamina and walking speed. Hearts absorb damage, stamina powers paraglider flight and mana pays for spells. Armor reduces incoming damage. Block reach measures how far you can build, break and use blocks.
aeroscapes_reimagine.race.profession_dra: No inherent penalties. Other professions’ abilities remain available in the profession tree.
aeroscapes_reimagine.race.profession_acc: Your profession grants one starting talent. Personal work earns progress toward further profession talents. If your inventory is full, make room to receive the rest of your supplies.
aeroscapes_reimagine.race.profession.bla: Start with tools for mining and fuel for your first smelt. Choose how to improve material repairs at the anvil.
aeroscapes_reimagine.race.profession.bui: Start with building material and an axe. Choose extra block reach or faster dismantling.
aeroscapes_reimagine.race.profession.far: Prepare a plot and sow your first seeds. Choose a harvesting or tilling ability.
aeroscapes_reimagine.race.profession.coo: Start with utensils and ingredients for mushroom stew. Choose what your personally prepared dishes do for the people who eat them.
aeroscapes_reimagine.change.choose: One Identity Seal changes your race, main class or profession. Choose what to change. You can review the result before spending the seal.
aeroscapes_reimagine.change.keep_kit: You keep your equipment, practice and studied spell ranks. Starter items are issued only at creation.
aeroscapes_reimagine.change.affected: Talents to remove, including dependent talents
aeroscapes_reimagine.change.seal_cost: Cost: 1 Identity Seal. Points freed: %1$s. Points assigned to the new starter: %2$s. All other investments stay in place.
aeroscapes_reimagine.change.advance: The new starter works immediately. Your next combat point covers it. Changing class again releases this advance if it is still outstanding.
aeroscapes_reimagine.change.refund_cost: Cost: 1 Knotted Thread. Points freed: %1$s. Penalty: %2$s. Available to spend: %3$s. Fraction carried towards the next penalty: %4$s/10. Each 3,000 new practice XP in this pool restores one lost point.
aeroscapes_reimagine.change.expired: The character or item changed. Use the item again to review the current choices.
aeroscapes_reimagine.change.error.point: There are too few points in this pool for the proposed change. Review the talents to return.
aeroscapes_reimagine.change.error.invali: This change is unavailable. Choose a different race, class or profession.
aeroscapes_reimagine.change.error.space: Move to an open space so the new body will fit. Then use the seal again.
aeroscapes_reimagine.change.error.talent: Select learned talents from one pool. Your active starting talents and their required prerequisites must stay.
